propositions: On Python 3.14, argparse colorizes help and error output by default, prepending ANSI escape sequences to stderr, breaking assertions that match on plain text like `startswith('usage:')`
Test assertions across 9 modules (25+ failures) fail under Python 3.14 when FORCE_COLOR is set or TTY is present, due to ANSI codes in rendered argparse output
RebarHelpFormatter._format_usage wraps on rendered line length, and ANSI escape sequences inflate that length, causing wrapped help text to differ for real users on Python 3.14
gen_cli_help.py --check reports all committed help/*.txt artifacts stale on Python 3.14 because generated help now includes ANSI color codes
Setting RebarArgumentParser.color = False disables colorization across the entire parser family via subparser inheritance on Python 3.14, with no effect on earlier versions
